c: A change with open tasks can't be closed.
say: When the work is done, close its tasks first. A change with open tasks can't be closed.
Press review, and check the result.

c: Close with a close code (Successful, Successful with issues, Unsuccessful) and notes.
say: Close it with a close code, successful, successful with issues, or unsuccessful, and close notes.

c: Cancel Change with a reason cancels its tasks too.
say: To cancel, choose cancel change and give the reason. Its tasks are canceled too.

c: Revert to New sends it back to fix the plan; Copy Change starts a new one.
say: Revert to new sends a change back to fix the plan. Copy change starts a new change from this one.
